items.title: Qualcomm, SpaceX deal could reshape the future of 5G
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts, Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian, and guest Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski discuss Qualcomm (QCOM)'s deal with SpaceX (SPCX) to use its Dragonwing technology to power a terrestrial 5G network. The panel examines what the partnership could mean for the future of wireless connectivity.

items.title: Elon says Grok Bot costs more than it makes
items.summary: Elon Musk says the cost of serving Grok Bot is unsustainably high relative to revenue, and usage limits just tightened for paying users. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why the same chips earn more rented to Anthropic, the $60 billion Cursor bet, the bear and bull case, and whether AI is too expensive at today's prices.

items.title: Qualcomm to supply equipment for SpaceX’s nationwide 5G mobile network
items.summary: Qualcomm Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) has secured a multiyear agreement to supply cellular infrastructure hardware and software for SpaceX's (NASDAQ:SPCX) planned nationwide terrestrial wireless network, marking a major step in Elon Musk’s drive to build a direct competitor to incumbent U.S. carriers. Under the partnership, SpaceX will deploy Qualcomm’s Dragonwing cellular platforms across tens of thousands of planned cell sites, with initial rollouts scheduled to begin in 2027.

items.title: Elon Musk is set to spend $100B to disrupt wireless in the age of drones and robots
items.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX is moving ahead with plans to build a nationwide cellular network, selecting Qualcomm to provide key technology for tens of thousands of cell sites that it plans to begin deploying next year.
